resolution.note: adopt writes krn.json from detection (kept when present), the Stop hook calling new 'krn hook stop', CI and tasks/ only on --ref/--tracker; proven on pytest and npm fixtures at test/adopt/adopt.test.ts. Proof run in full.

title: krn adopt writes the repo contract and the worker hooks into any repository
body:
Why: adopt writes only a krn-works CI workflow ref, rules R-1..R-4 and a tasks/ seed (src/adopt/adopt.ts:28,32-37,150-178); a foreign repo gets no hooks and no test contract.
After: t-p226jft (Stop check) and t-pvhs4eb (lane).
Outcome: adopt writes krn.json from detection (operator may edit), .claude/settings.json hooks calling krn hook, an optional tracker seed, and CI only on request.
Proof: adopt on pytest and npm fixture repos yields a contract that krn repo contract reads back and hooks that run.
Scope: src/adopt/, src/cli/, test/.

Carried from t-p226jft: hooks run as `krn hook <name>` from the installed binary (the Stop check is scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts, contract-driven since t-p226jft); adopt installs them, so the CLI entry ships here.
